parameters.query:
with checks as (
  select
    data_domain,
    latest_data_at,
    data_age,
    records_recent,
    case
      when data_domain = 'grid_frequency' and (latest_data_at is null or data_age > interval '30 seconds') then 'critical'
      when data_domain = 'grid_time_deviation' and (latest_data_at is null or data_age > interval '60 seconds') then 'warning'
      when data_domain = 'market_price_points' and (latest_data_at is null or records_recent = 0) then 'warning'
      else null
    end as severity
  from energy_data.v_ingestion_health
), resolved as (
  update energy_data.ingestion_alerts a
  set resolved_at = now(), last_seen_at = now()
  where a.workflow_name = 'ingestion_health_monitor'
    and a.resolved_at is null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from checks c
      where c.data_domain = a.metadata ->> 'data_domain'
        and c.severity is not null
    )
  returning 1
), refreshed as (
  update energy_data.ingestion_alerts a
  set
    severity = c.severity,
    message = c.data_domain || ' appears stale or empty',
    last_seen_at = now(),
    metadata = jsonb_build_object(
      'data_domain', c.data_domain,
      'latest_data_at', c.latest_data_at,
      'data_age', c.data_age::text,
      'records_recent', c.records_recent
    )
  from checks c
  where a.workflow_name = 'ingestion_health_monitor'
    and a.resolved_at is null
    and a.metadata ->> 'data_domain' = c.data_domain
    and c.severity is not null
  returning 1
), inserted as (
  insert into energy_data.ingestion_alerts (workflow_name, severity, message, metadata)
  select
    'ingestion_health_monitor',
    c.severity,
    c.data_domain || ' appears stale or empty',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'data_domain', c.data_domain,
      'latest_data_at', c.latest_data_at,
      'data_age', c.data_age::text,
      'records_recent', c.records_recent
    )
  from checks c
  where c.severity is not null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from energy_data.ingestion_alerts a
      where a.workflow_name = 'ingestion_health_monitor'
        and a.resolved_at is null
        and a.metadata ->> 'data_domain' = c.data_domain
    )
  returning 1
)
insert into energy_data.ingestion_runs (
  workflow_name,
  source_id,
  finished_at,
  status,
  records_read,
  records_written
)
select
  'ingestion_health_monitor',
  (select id from energy_data.data_sources where code = 'calculated'),
  now(),
  'success',
  (select count(*)::integer from checks),
  (select count(*)::integer from resolved)
    + (select count(*)::integer from refreshed)
    + (select count(*)::integer from inserted);
